opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of The Genetics Society: undergraduate, MSc and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva; UK‑based members for non‑UK conferences; one grant per two years for schemes B/C.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences) by covering travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course is held in the UK. Students must be members; other applicants need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics/genomics training courses or collaborative visits to another laboratory.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation costs for field‑based genetic research projects, with awards typically up to £1,700 (maximum £2,000).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.
